subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

Her million-dollar wedding was a ________ display of wealth. (pompous)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pompous"** means affectedly grand, solemn, or self-important. (घमंडी)

 
 
• **Example: **The** pompous **king demanded that everyone bow before him.
 
 
 
• **"Pretentious"** refers to attempting to impress by affecting greater importance, talent, culture, etc., than is actually possessed. (दिखावटी)
 
 
• **Example: **Her** pretentious **mannerisms made her unpopular among her peers.
 
 
 
• Hence,** "pretentious" **is the most appropriate synonym for** "pompous."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prestigious** (प्रतिष्ठित): Having high status or respect in the community.

 
 
• **Example:** He graduated from a prestigious university.
 
 
 
• **Outrageous** (अपमानजनक): Shockingly bad or excessive.
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian’s outrageous jokes offended many in the audience.
 
 
 
• **Mock** (मजाक): To tease or laugh at in a scornful or contemptuous manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The students mocked the teacher's accent.
